hypotheses.justification: By definition, f.ker is the largest ideal sheaf contained componentwise in RingHom.ker (f.app U).hom. Each such ring kernel is radical by Ideal.isRadical_bot.comap, since IsReduced X makes every section ring reduced. Thus f.ideal_ker_le U and Ideal.IsRadical.radical_le_iff show that f.ker.radical is still componentwise contained in these kernels. Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_ofIdeals_iff gives f.ker.radical ≤ f.ker; the reverse inequality is Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_radical. This replaces the quasi-compactness-dependent ker_apply step. The argument also covers trivial section rings and empty schemes; for an empty source the kernel is top, whose radical is top.
